title: 第12章  城主夫人竟然叫楚枫夫君？
content_zh:
子书禾低着头，根本不敢去看众人的表情。
真正的夫君才死了不到一年，转头便投入其他男人的怀抱嗯，大家会不会认为她是一个荡妇？
然而，子书禾并不后悔，她一个人撑着实在太累了。
一个能够驯服四阶妖兽的御兽师，做他的妾也不是不能接受。
最重要的是她没得选，王澶已经突破到了元婴境，如果没有楚枫，她只会沦为王澶的炉鼎。
相比之下，她更希望做楚枫的妾，至少……他不只是口气大。
“夫……夫君。”
这两个字如同惊雷般在妖兽院炸响，瞬间压过了所有的嘈杂。
寂静，死一般的寂静。
在场的所有人都僵在了原地，眼睛瞪得滚圆，仿佛听到了世间最荒谬的事情。
空气仿佛凝固了，只剩下天煞鬼虎低沉的呜咽声和众人粗重的呼吸声。
“主母她……她竟然叫楚枫夫君？”
“楚枫虽然驯服了天煞鬼虎，但他终究是外人。”
“堂堂城主夫人竟然当众叫一个外人夫君，对得起逝去的城主吗？”
这些长老皆是忠于王云山之人，此刻一个个脸色涨红，显然无法接受子书禾当众认楚枫为夫君的事实。
在他们心中，子书禾是前任城主的遗孀，理应坚守名节，守护城主府。
然而也有几位长老选择了沉默，他们都很清楚，事到如今，这或许是最好的选择了。
王澶已经突破元婴境，他绝不会放过子书禾，更不会放过他们这些忠于城主的人。
楚枫能够驯服天煞鬼虎，便已经拥有了与王澶抗衡的实力，甚至有了掌控整个青山城的资本。
子书禾与他绑定在一起，才能保住城主府，保住他们这些人。

四长老站了出来，冷声道。
“主母这是为了保住我们的性命。”
这番话如同醍醐灌顶，让那些激动的长老们瞬间冷静了下来。
王澶心狠手辣，如今已是元婴境强者，若是没有楚枫和天煞鬼虎，他们根本不是王澶的对手，最终只会落得个死无全尸的下场。
“可是……”
三长老还想说什么，但看着楚枫脚边温顺的天煞鬼虎，最终还是把话咽了回去。
众人的议论声虽然不大，却清晰地传入了王澶的耳中。
他看着被楚枫搂在怀里的子书禾，看着她脸上那抹娇羞的红晕，一股难以遏制的怒火瞬间从胸腔中爆发出来。
子书禾是他看中的炉鼎，是他突破元婴境后，进一步提升修为的关键。
他早就对子书禾的极阴灵体垂涎三尺，之前碍于王云山，一直没有下手。
如今，他好不容易突破元婴境，以为可以为所欲为。
却没想到，自己看中的女人，竟然当众认别的男人为夫君，还被搂在怀里，这简直是对他的奇耻大辱！
“楚枫，放开你的爪子！”
王澶怒吼一声，元婴境的威压再次暴涨。
“子书禾是老夫看中的女人，你也敢染指？
今日，老夫不仅要杀了你，还要将你挫骨扬灰，让你知道得罪老夫的下场！”
楚枫嘴角勾起一抹冰冷的讥讽，而后抬手拍了拍天煞鬼虎的脑袋。
“给我咬死他！”
天煞鬼虎立刻抬起头，赤红的竖瞳瞬间锁定了王澶，喉咙里发出低沉的咆哮，身上的凶煞之气再次爆发出来。
一声震耳欲聋的虎啸再次响彻天地！

天煞鬼虎四肢猛地蹬地，巨大的身躯如同离弦之箭般弹射而出，朝着王澶猛冲而去。
它的速度快得惊人，带起一阵狂风，地面被它的爪子划出四道深深的沟壑，碎石飞溅。
王澶脸色一沉，眼中闪过一丝凝重，这天煞鬼虎竟然如此听从楚枫的命令。
他不敢大意，双脚轻轻一点地面，身形瞬间腾空而起，化作一道青虹，冲向天空。
天煞鬼虎见状，毫不犹豫地纵身一跃，庞大的身躯竟然如同飞鸟般腾空，紧随其后，朝着王澶追去。
王澶身在高空，双手结印。
元婴境的灵力疯狂涌动，汇聚成一道道璀璨的灵光，周围的天地之力也被他调动起来，天空中的云层翻滚。
“青冥雷动掌！”
王澶怒吼一声，双手猛地向前推出。
两道巨大的青色掌印凝聚而成，掌印上缠绕着密密麻麻的紫色雷电，朝着天煞鬼虎狠狠拍去。
这门地阶武技只有元婴境修士才能催动，威力无穷，一掌下去，足以劈山裂石。
青色掌印所过之处，紫色雷电噼啪作响，照亮了整个天空，让地面上的众人都忍不住眯起了眼睛。
“这就是地阶武技吗，太恐怖了！”
“大长老果然厉害，突破元婴境之后，实力当真是深不可测。”
“天煞鬼虎这次恐怕凶多吉少了，地阶武技可不是那么容易抵挡的。”
然而，天煞鬼虎眼中没有丝毫畏惧，反而闪过一丝狂暴的凶光。
它猛地张开大嘴，发出一声震天动地的咆哮，巨大的虎爪上覆盖上一层厚厚的玄铁光泽，朝着青色掌印狠狠拍去。
一声震耳欲聋的巨响，青色掌印与虎爪狠狠碰撞在一起。
紫色的雷电瞬间爆发开来，如同漫天烟花般绚烂，巨大的冲击波朝着四周扩散开来，天空中的云层被震散，形成一个巨大的真空地带。
令人震惊的是，王澶全力施展的地阶武技，竟然被天煞鬼虎一爪子拍碎了。

青色掌印寸寸碎裂，紫色雷电也瞬间消散，化作点点灵光。
王澶只觉得一股巨大的反震力顺着手臂传来，体内的灵力剧烈震荡，喉咙一甜，险些喷出一口鲜血。
他的身形如同断线的风筝般向后倒飞出去，足足后退了数丈之远，才勉强稳住身形。
“好、好厉害的孽畜！”
众人也被这一幕惊呆了。
“天煞鬼虎竟然挡住了地阶武技！”
王天寿站在人群中，看着天空中占据上风的天煞鬼虎，心中顿时升起一股危机感。
他很清楚，再这么继续下去，父亲必定会败在天煞鬼虎手中。
到时候，他们这一脉的所有人都难逃一死！
他的目光快速转动，瞬间落在了楚枫身上。
楚枫是天煞鬼虎的主人，只要杀了楚枫，天煞鬼虎便会失去控制，到时候，父亲就有机会反败为胜！
想到这里，王天寿眼中闪过一丝狠厉。
他猛地拔出腰间的长刀，对着身后的众人怒吼道。
“杀了楚枫，这只孽畜就会失控，大家一起上！”
此话一出，众人顿时齐声附和。
“对，杀了楚枫！”
他们纷纷拔出武器，朝着楚枫齐齐冲去。
一时间，杀气腾腾，无数把武器闪烁着寒芒，朝着楚枫笼罩而去。
子书禾身边的几位长老脸色瞬间变得凝重起来，四长老皱着眉头，看着冲过来的密密麻麻的人群，低声向子书禾询问道。
“主母，对方人多势众，我们要不要出手？”

在他看来，人力终有尽时，楚枫就算再强，也绝不可能在灵力耗尽之前杀光所有人。
想要保住楚枫，保住城主府，他们必须出手相助。
然而，还没等子书禾开口，楚枫便动了。
他抬头看向冲过来的众人，嘴角勾起一抹冰冷的弧度。
周身瞬间爆发出金丹五重的磅礴威压，白色长袍无风自动，鼓荡不休，长发如同墨龙般飞舞。
“关门，一个不留！”
话音刚落，子书禾举起了手中的城主令。
城主令瞬间爆发出璀璨的金光，一道巨大的金色屏障凭空出现，如同一个倒扣的金碗，将整个城主府笼罩其中。
这枚城主令可不仅仅只是一个象征身份的摆设，更是城主府的镇府之宝，能够催动城主府传承已久的护府大阵。
正是因为这枚城主令和护府大阵，王澶在突破元婴境之前，才始终对子书禾有所忌惮，不敢轻易动手。
如今，大阵启动，相当于关门打狗，将所有王家的人都困在了城主府之中。
下一刻，楚枫身形瞬间来到了王天寿的面前。
王天寿脸色大变，他下意识地举起长刀，朝着楚枫狠狠劈去。
然而，他的动作在楚枫面前，慢得如同蜗牛。
一道寒芒闪过，王天寿甚至没有看清楚枫的动作，便觉得身体一轻，紧接着，剧痛传来。
他低头看去，长刀竟然被劈成了两段，掉落在地，发出清脆的声响。
与此同时，他的身体从肩膀到胯部也出现一道剑痕，鲜血喷涌而出。
连人带刀，尽皆两断！
楚枫没有丝毫停顿，星辞剑快速震荡，剑身上沾染的王天寿的血液随着震荡蒸腾，化作一团血雾，弥漫在空气中，让他看起来如同妖似魔。
他如同虎入羊群，在人群中穿梭，身影所过之处，惨叫声此起彼伏。

星辞剑每一次挥动，都能带起一道凄厉的血光，凡是挡在他面前的人，尽皆被一剑两断，没有任何一合之敌。
“不要杀我，我投降！”
“楚枫饶命，我再也不敢了！”
“大长老，救我啊，您快下来救我！”
“爷爷，王天寿已经死了，您再不管我们都要死了！”
求饶声、惨叫声、武器落地的声响交织在一起，众人被楚枫的凶残吓得魂飞魄散，纷纷想要逃跑。
可是楚枫速度极快，他们还没跑出妖兽院，便已经被一一斩杀。
子书禾身边的几位长老，早已被眼前这血腥而震撼的一幕惊呆了。
他们瞪大了眼睛，嘴巴张得能塞进一个鸡蛋，喉咙不断滚动，却一句话也说不出来。
“楚枫竟然突破到了金、金丹五重！”
“那、那难道是圣阶武技？”
“楚枫竟然掌握了圣阶武技，这怎么可能？”
四长老喉咙滚动了一下，露出一丝苦笑。
他这才发现，自己之前想要帮楚枫的想法，是多么的可笑。
以楚枫的实力对付这些人，根本不需要他们出手。
子书禾站在原地，看着楚枫在人群中如同无人之境般厮杀，娇躯微微颤动。
她越来越觉得，楚枫绝非池中之物。
他年纪轻轻便拥有金丹五重的修为，掌握了圣阶武技，还能驯服四阶妖兽。
这份天赋与实力，简直是百年难遇，甚至千年难遇。
这样的人，注定不会被青山城这方小天地所束缚。

日后，他必定能够一飞冲天，驰骋天下，成为一方巨擘！
而这样的人，竟然是她的夫君。
想到这里，子书禾的丰腴美腿不由得并拢的几分，轻轻摩挲着。
院中死寂一片，不过几个呼吸的功夫，妖兽院变成了人间炼狱，满地都是残肢断臂与冰冷的尸体。
唯有墙角处，还缩着一道纤弱的身影，王莹。
她浑身筛糠般发抖，双手死死抱住脑袋，牙齿不受控制地打颤。
她涣散的目光，死死盯着离自己不远的一具尸体，那是她的堂兄，身首异处，死不瞑目。
“死了，都死了……”王莹的嘴唇哆嗦着，“爷爷的人，父亲的人，全都死了……”
亲眼看着身边之人一个个倒在血泊中，惨叫声、求饶声此起彼伏，最终都归于沉寂。
恐惧让她连呼吸都变得艰难，甚至控制不住地尿湿了裙摆，一股腥臊味弥漫开来，可她却浑然不觉。
就在这时，耳边的脚步声越来越近。
王莹的身体猛地一僵，缓缓抬起头，透过模糊的泪眼，看到了手持星辞剑的楚枫，正一步步朝着她走来。
楚枫眼神冰冷，如同在看一个死人。
“不，你不要过来啊！”
楚枫脚步未停，距离她越来越近。
王莹再也撑不住，直接跪在了地上连连磕头。
“求你了，求求你放过我……”
“我知道错了，求你看在我只是个女人的份上，饶我一命。”
“我愿意做牛做马，伺候你一辈子。”
楚枫停下脚步，居高临下地看着她，手中的星辞剑微微抬起，剑尖对准了她的眉心。

就在楚枫即将挥剑的瞬间，异变陡生。
一声撕心裂肺的惨叫突然从天空中传来，所有人的目光瞬间被吸引到天空中，包括楚枫和王莹。
只见天空之中，天煞鬼虎正死死抓在王澶的胸口。
锋利的爪子穿透了王澶的护体灵光，轻易地撕裂了他的衣袍。
嗤啦——
天煞鬼虎猛地发力，硬生生将王澶的一条右臂从肩膀处撕了下来。
鲜血如同喷泉般从王澶的肩膀处喷涌而出，染红了大片天空。
那条还在抽搐的手臂，带着淋漓的鲜血，从高空坠落。
王澶的胸口已经被抓得血肉模糊，白骨外露，狰狞可怖。
他的五官因剧痛而扭曲在一起，口中喷出一大口鲜血。
然而，此刻想要后退已经晚了。
“孽畜，你敢！”
还没等他从断臂的剧痛中回过神来，天煞鬼虎那条粗壮如钢鞭的尾巴，已经带着呼啸的风声，狠狠抽在了他的腹部！
“轰！”
一声巨响，王澶如同被巨石击中的破布娃娃，整个身体瞬间被抽飞出去，以极快的速度砸向地面。
王澶重重地砸在妖兽院的空地上，地面瞬间被砸出一个巨大的深坑。
他的身体陷在深坑之中，手脚扭曲成诡异的角度。
墙角处的王莹，亲眼目睹了这一幕，脸上的血色瞬间褪得一干二净，连嘴唇都变得乌青。
她的身体软软地瘫倒在地，眼中的最后一丝希望彻底破灭了。
原本还抱着一丝侥幸，期望着爷爷能够力挽狂澜，斩杀天煞鬼虎，然后杀了楚枫，为她的父亲和族人报仇。

可现在……完了，彻底完了。
就在这时，深坑中的王澶突然动了。
他艰难地抬起头，浑浊的眼睛死死盯着不远处的楚枫，眼神中充满了怨毒。
“为什么要逼我？”
话音落下的瞬间，王澶的身形突然悬浮于半空之中。
紧接着，一股浓郁到令人作呕的血色雾气，从他的体内涌出，如同潮水般扩散开来，很快就笼罩了整个城主府。
那血色雾气所过之处，地面上的鲜血纷纷漂浮起来，融入雾气之中。
与此同时，王澶的身躯以肉眼可见的速度变得干瘪下去，皮肤紧紧贴在骨骼上，如同脱水的干尸一般。
他的双眼却变得越来越猩红，充满了邪异的光芒。
子书禾站在一旁，看着这诡异的一幕，脸色骤变，心中猛地咯噔一下。
她仿佛想到了什么，失声惊呼道。
“不好，他要施展血脉献祭！”
闻听此言，四长老等人皆是脸色一变。
那是早已失传的禁术，据说施展此术，能够将自己一脉所有子孙的精血尽数炼化为己用，强行提升自身实力。
但代价极大，不仅会折损寿元，还会断子绝孙。
“快阻止他！”
子书禾反应过来，率先朝着王澶冲了过去。
四长老等人也不敢迟疑，纷纷运转灵力，想要阻止王澶施展禁术。
然而，王澶只是冷冷地瞥了他们一眼，抬手便是一掌拍出。
血色雾气凝聚成一只巨大的手掌，狠狠拍向子书禾和四长老等人。

“砰！”
众人根本无法抵挡这股诡异的力量，瞬间被拍飞出去，重重地砸在地上，喷出一口鲜血，一时间难以起身。
天煞鬼虎见状，怒吼一声，庞大的身躯如同离弦之箭般冲向王澶，巨大的虎爪狠狠拍向王澶。
然而，王澶周身的血色雾气突然凝聚成一层厚厚的血色屏障，将他牢牢护住。
“轰！”
天煞鬼虎的虎爪狠狠拍在血色屏障上，发出一声震耳欲聋的巨响，血色屏障剧烈震荡起来，泛起阵阵涟漪，却始终没有破碎。
天煞鬼虎接连拍出数爪，都无法轻易轰碎这层血色屏障，只能愤怒地咆哮着，围绕着王澶不断盘旋。
就在这时，墙角处的王莹突然发出一声凄厉的惨叫。
只见王莹的身体开始不受控制地颤抖起来，一股淡红色的气流从她的七窍中涌出，朝着半空中的王澶飘去，那是她体内的精血。
王莹惊恐地发现，自己的身体正在以肉眼可见的速度变得干枯下去，皮肤失去了光泽，变得褶皱不堪，头发也开始变得花白。
那种感觉，就像是被一只无形的大手，抽走了她所有的生机。
“爷爷，那是我的精血，你快停下来！”
可王澶却如同没有听到一般，依旧疯狂地吞噬着她的精血。
不仅是王莹，她这一脉所有人的精血都被强行抽离，化作一道道红色气流，融入血色雾气之中。
就在这时，楚枫从怀中掏出一个小玉瓶，拔掉瓶塞，将里面的白色药粉尽数倒进了王莹的嘴里。
“快吃下去。”
王莹下意识地咽了下去，她以为楚枫是良心发现，想要救她一命，眼中瞬间闪过一丝感激之色，虚弱地开口道。
“谢……谢谢你。”
然而，话音刚落，一股剧烈的疼痛突然从她的腹部传来，疼得她浑身抽搐，脸色瞬间变得乌青。
“你……你给我吃了什么？”

楚枫神色淡漠地开口道。
“毒药。”
王莹张了张嘴，想要咒骂楚枫，却只能发出微弱的“嗬嗬”声，身体抽搐了几下，便彻底没了气息。
半空中，王澶疯狂地吞噬着所有王家子孙的精血，周身的血色雾气越来越浓郁，他那干瘪的身体，竟然开始以肉眼可见的速度膨胀起来。
原本如同干尸般的身躯，渐渐变得富态，皮肤重新变得光滑，甚至比之前还要红润。
随着精血的不断涌入，王澶身上的气息也在飞速攀升。
元婴一重，元婴二重，元婴三重！
子书禾看着王澶的变化，眼中满是愤怒之色。
她挣扎着从地上爬起来，怒声斥道。
“王澶，你竟然连自己的血脉至亲都要炼化，你还是不是人！”
王澶仰天大笑起来，笑声中充满了疯狂。
“这都是你们逼我的！”
他死死盯着楚枫身上，恨声道。
“楚枫，我的儿子死了，我的族人死了，我的一切都被你毁了！
今天，你们所有人都要死！”
话音落下的瞬间，王澶再也不顾一旁咆哮的天煞鬼虎，身形径直朝着楚枫冲了过去。
他现在的修为已经达到元婴三重，他若是想要杀楚枫，天煞鬼虎也未必能拦的住。
子书禾看到王澶冲向楚枫，顿时呼吸一滞。
“楚枫，小心！”
王澶的速度快得惊人，几乎在子书禾的惊呼声落下的瞬间，他就已经出现在了楚枫的面前。

他的眼中满是疯狂的杀意，右手成爪，带着凌厉的劲风，朝着楚枫的头颅狠狠抓去。
“给我死！”
然而，面对这致命的一击，楚枫却站在原地一动不动，脸上没有丝毫惊慌，甚至连眼神都没有变化，仿佛被吓傻了一般。
子书禾的心脏瞬间提到了嗓子眼，眼中满是绝望。
“不——”
content_en:
Zi Shuhe lowered his head, not daring to look at everyone's expressions.
The real husband died less than a year ago, and then turned around and fell into the arms of other men. Well, will everyone think that she is a slut?
However, Zi Shuhe did not regret it. She was too tired to support it alone.
A beast master who can tame a fourth-level monster is not unacceptable as his concubine.
The most important thing is that she has no choice. Wang Chan has already broken through to the Nascent Soul Realm. Without Chu Feng, she will only become Wang Chan's cauldron.
In contrast, she would rather be Chu Feng's concubine, at least...he doesn't just have a loud mouth.
"Husband...husband."
These two words exploded like thunder in the Monster Beast Courtyard, instantly overwhelming all the noise.
Silence, deathly silence.
Everyone present froze on the spot, their eyes widened, as if they had heard the most ridiculous thing in the world.
The air seemed to have solidified, leaving only the deep whimpering sounds of the evil spirits and ghost tigers and the heavy breathing of everyone.
"Mother, she...she actually called Chu Feng, husband?"
"Although Chu Feng has tamed the evil ghost tiger, he is still an outsider after all."
"The wife of the dignified city lord actually called an outsider her husband in public. Is she worthy of the deceased city lord?"
These elders were all loyal to Wang Yunshan, and their faces were all red at this moment. It was obvious that they could not accept the fact that Zi Shuhe recognized Chu Feng as her husband in public.
In their hearts, Zi Shuhe is the widow of the former city lord, and she should stick to her honor and protect the city lord's mansion.
However, there are also a few elders who have chosen to remain silent. They all know that at this point, this may be the best choice.
Wang Chan has broken through to the Nascent Soul realm, and he will never let Zi Shuhe go, let alone those of them who are loyal to the city lord.
If Chu Feng could tame the Heavenly Evil Ghost Tiger, he already had the strength to compete with Wang Chan, and even had the capital to control the entire Qingshan City.
Zi Shuhe is bound to him in order to protect the city lord's mansion and these people.
The fourth elder stood up and said coldly.
"Mother, this is to save our lives."
These words were like a revelation, causing the excited elders to calm down instantly.
Wang Chan is ruthless and ruthless, and is now a strong man in the Nascent Soul Realm. If it were not for Chu Feng and Tiansha Guihu, they would not be Wang Chan's opponents at all, and they would only end up dead without a whole body.
"But..."
The third elder wanted to say something more, but looking at the docile Tiansha Ghost Tiger at Chu Feng's feet, he finally swallowed his words.
Although the crowd's discussion was not loud, it was clearly transmitted to Wang Chan's ears.
He looked at Zi Shuhe who was held in Chu Feng's arms and the shy blush on her face, and an uncontrollable anger instantly burst out from his chest.
Zi Shuhe is the furnace he likes, and it is the key to further improving his cultivation after breaking through to the Nascent Soul Realm.
He had long been coveting Zi Shuhe's extremely yin spirit body, but he had never made a move because of Wang Yunshan.
Now, he finally broke through to the Nascent Soul Realm and thought he could do whatever he wanted.
But he didn't expect that the woman he liked would recognize another man as her husband in public and be held in his arms. This was a great shame and humiliation for him!
"Chu Feng, let go of your claws!"
Wang Chan roared angrily, and the pressure of the Nascent Soul Realm surged again.
"Zi Shuhe is the woman I like, how dare you get involved?
Today, I will not only kill you, but also reduce you to ashes and let you know the consequences of offending me! "
The corner of Chu Feng's mouth curled up with a touch of cold sarcasm, and then he raised his hand and patted the Tiansha Guihu on the head.
"Bite him to death!"
The Tiansha Guihu immediately raised his head, and his red vertical pupils instantly locked onto Wang Chan. He let out a deep roar from his throat, and the evil aura on his body burst out again.
A deafening tiger roar resounded throughout the world again!
The Tiansha Ghost Tiger kicked the ground violently with its limbs, and its huge body shot out like an arrow from a string, rushing towards Wang Chan.
Its speed is astonishingly fast, carryingThere was a strong wind, and its claws carved four deep ravines on the ground, causing gravel to fly.
Wang Chan's face darkened, and a trace of solemnity flashed in his eyes. This evil ghost tiger actually obeyed Chu Feng's orders like this.
He didn't dare to be careless, he touched the ground lightly with his feet, and his figure instantly rose into the air, turning into a blue rainbow and rushing into the sky.
Seeing this, the Tiansha Ghost Tiger jumped up without hesitation, its huge body soaring into the air like a bird, and followed closely behind, chasing Wang Chan.
Wang Chan was high in the sky, forming seals with his hands.
The spiritual power of the Nascent Soul Realm surged crazily, converging into bright spiritual lights. The power of the surrounding heaven and earth was also mobilized by him, and the clouds in the sky rolled.
"Qing Ming Lei moves his palm!"
Wang Chan roared angrily and pushed forward with both hands.
Two huge cyan palm prints were condensed. The palm prints were wrapped with dense purple thunder and lightning, and they were fiercely swatted towards the evil ghost tiger.
This earth-level martial skill can only be activated by Yuanying realm monks. It is extremely powerful. One palm strike is enough to split mountains and crack rocks.
Wherever the cyan palm print passed, purple thunder and lightning crackled, lighting up the entire sky and making everyone on the ground couldn't help but squint their eyes.
"Is this an earth-level martial skill? It's too terrifying!"
"The Great Elder is really powerful. After breaking through to the Nascent Soul Realm, his strength is really unfathomable."
"I'm afraid the evil spirits and ghost tigers will be in trouble this time. Earth-level martial arts are not so easy to resist."
However, there was no fear in Tiansha Guihu's eyes, but a violent and fierce light flashed in his eyes.
It suddenly opened its big mouth and let out an earth-shattering roar. Its huge tiger claws were covered with a thick layer of dark iron luster, and it struck hard at the blue palm prints.
There was a deafening loud noise, and the green palm print and the tiger's claw collided fiercely.
Purple thunder and lightning burst out instantly, as brilliant as fireworks all over the sky. A huge shock wave spread in all directions, and the clouds in the sky were shaken away, forming a huge vacuum zone.
What is shocking is that Wang Chan's earth-level martial arts, which he used with all his strength, were smashed to pieces by the claws of the evil ghost tiger.
The cyan palm prints shattered inch by inch, and the purple thunder and lightning dissipated instantly, turning into little auras.
Wang Chan only felt a huge counter-shock force coming down his arm. The spiritual power in his body shook violently. His throat felt sweet and he almost spit out a mouthful of blood.
His body flew backwards like a kite with its string broken, and he retreated several feet before he could barely stabilize his body.
"What a powerful evil beast!"
Everyone was also stunned by this scene.
"The evil ghost tiger actually blocked the earth-level martial arts!"
Wang Tianshou stood in the crowd, looking at the evil ghost tiger that had the upper hand in the sky, and a sense of crisis suddenly arose in his heart.
He knew very well that if he continued like this, his father would definitely be defeated by the evil spirits and ghost tigers.
By then, everyone in their lineage will inevitably die!
His eyes turned quickly and instantly fell on Chu Feng.
Chu Feng is the master of the Heavenly Evil Ghost Tiger. As long as Chu Feng is killed, the Heavenly Evil Ghost Tiger will lose control. At that time, my father will have the opportunity to turn defeat into victory!
Thinking of this, Wang Tianshou's eyes flashed with fierceness.
He suddenly pulled out the long knife from his waist and roared at the people behind him.
"Kill Chu Feng and this evil beast will lose control. Let's all fight together!"
As soon as these words came out, everyone immediately echoed in unison.
"Yes, kill Chu Feng!"
They all pulled out their weapons and rushed towards Chu Feng.
For a moment, murderous intent filled the air, and countless weapons shone with cold light, shrouding Chu Feng.
The expressions of the elders around Zi Shuhe instantly became serious. The fourth elder frowned, looked at the dense crowd rushing over, and asked Zi Shuhe in a low voice.
"Mother, the other party has a large number of people. Do we want to take action?"
In his opinion, when his manpower will eventually be exhausted, no matter how strong Chu Feng is, he will never be able to kill everyone before his spiritual power is exhausted.
If they want to keep Chu Feng and the city lord's mansion, they mustHelp.
However, before Zi Shuhe could speak, Chu Feng moved.
He raised his head and looked at the people rushing over, with a cold arc at the corner of his mouth.
The majestic pressure of the fifth level of the golden elixir suddenly erupted all over his body. His white robe automatically wavered without wind, and his long hair flew like an ink dragon.
"Close the door, leave no one behind!"
As soon as he finished speaking, Zi Shuhe raised the City Lord's Order in his hand.
The City Lord's order instantly erupted with bright golden light, and a huge golden barrier appeared out of thin air, like an upside-down golden bowl, covering the entire City Lord's Mansion.
This City Lord's Order is not only a decoration that symbolizes status, but also the treasure of the City Lord's Mansion, which can activate the long-established protective formation of the City Lord's Mansion.
It was precisely because of this City Lord's Order and the Palace Guard Formation that Wang Chan was always wary of Zi Shuhe and did not dare to take action easily before he broke through to the Nascent Soul Realm.
Now, the formation is activated, which is equivalent to closing the door and beating the dog, trapping all the Wang family members in the city lord's mansion.
The next moment, Chu Feng appeared in front of Wang Tianshou.
Wang Tianshou's expression changed drastically. He subconsciously raised his long knife and struck hard at Chu Feng.
However, his movements were as slow as a snail in front of Chu Feng.
A cold light flashed through, and Wang Tianshou didn't even see Feng's movements clearly before he felt his body light up, followed by severe pain.
He looked down and saw that the long knife was split into two pieces and fell to the ground with a crisp sound.
At the same time, a sword mark appeared on his body from his shoulder to his crotch, and blood spurted out.
Even the person with the knife will be cut off in two!
Chu Feng didn't pause at all. The Xingci Sword vibrated rapidly. Wang Tianshou's blood stained on the sword evaporated with the vibration, turning into a blood mist that filled the air, making him look like a demon.
He was like a tiger among sheep, shuttling through the crowd. Wherever his figure passed, screams could be heard one after another.
Every time the Xingci Sword is swung, it can bring out a shrill bloody light. Anyone who stands in front of him will be cut in two with one sword, and no one can defeat him.
"Don't kill me, I surrender!"
"Chu Feng, spare your life, I don't dare to do it anymore!"
"Great Elder, save me, come down and save me!"
"Grandpa, Wang Tianshou is dead. If you don't care about us anymore, we will die!"
The sounds of begging for mercy, screams, and the sound of weapons falling to the ground were intertwined. Everyone was frightened out of their wits by Chu Feng's ferocity, and they all wanted to escape.
However, Chu Feng was extremely fast, and they were killed one by one before they even ran out of the Monster Beast Courtyard.
Several elders around Zi Shuhe were already stunned by the bloody and shocking scene in front of them.
Their eyes were wide open, their mouths were wide enough to fit an egg in, their throats were rolling, but they couldn't say a word.
"Chu Feng actually broke through to the fifth level of gold and golden elixir!"
"Then, is that a holy level martial skill?"
"Chu Feng actually mastered holy-level martial arts. How is this possible?"
The fourth elder's throat rolled and he smiled bitterly.
Only then did he realize how ridiculous his previous idea of ​​helping Chu Feng was.
With Chu Feng's strength to deal with these people, they don't need to take action at all.
Zi Shuhe stood there, watching Chu Feng fighting in the crowd as if there was no one around, his delicate body trembling slightly.
She felt more and more that Chu Feng was definitely not a thing in the pool.
At a young age, he possesses the fifth level of Golden Core cultivation, has mastered holy level martial arts, and can tame fourth level monsters.
This kind of talent and strength is simply rare to see in a hundred years, or even a thousand years.
Such people are destined not to be bound by the small world of Qingshan City.
In the future, he will definitely be able to soar into the sky, gallop around the world, and become a giant!
And such a person turned out to be her husband.
Thinking of this, Zi Shuhe's plump and beautiful legs couldn't help but move closer together and rub them gently.
There was deathly silence in the courtyard. In just a few breaths, the Monster Academy turned into a purgatory on earth, with broken limbs and ice everywhere.Cold bodies.
Only in the corner was a delicate figure, Wang Ying.
She was shaking like chaff, holding her head tightly with both hands, and her teeth were chattering uncontrollably.
Her distracted eyes were fixed on a corpse not far from her. It was her cousin, whose head was in a different place and he died with his eyes open.
"Dead, all dead..." Wang Ying's lips trembled, "Grandpa's people, father's people, all dead..."
I watched with my own eyes as the people around me fell into a pool of blood one by one, with screams and begging for mercy coming and going, but they all fell silent in the end.
Fear made it difficult for her to breathe, and she even wet the hem of her skirt uncontrollably. A fishy smell filled the air, but she was completely unaware of it.
At this moment, the footsteps in my ears were getting closer and closer.
Wang Ying's body stiffened suddenly, and she slowly raised her head. Through her blurred tearful eyes, she saw Chu Feng holding the Xingci Sword, walking towards her step by step.
Chu Feng's eyes were cold, as if he were looking at a dead person.
"No, don't come over!"
Chu Feng didn't stop, getting closer and closer to her.
Wang Ying couldn't hold on any longer and knelt on the ground and kowtowed repeatedly.
"Please, please let me go..."
"I know I was wrong. Please spare my life for the sake of me being just a woman."
"I am willing to be a cow or a horse and serve you all my life."
Chu Feng stopped and looked at her condescendingly. The Xingci Sword in his hand was slightly raised, and the tip of the sword was aimed at her eyebrows.
Just when Chu Feng was about to swing his sword, a sudden change occurred.
A heartbreaking scream suddenly came from the sky, and everyone's eyes were instantly attracted to the sky, including Chu Feng and Wang Ying.
In the sky, he saw the evil ghost tiger clinging to Wang Chan's chest.
The sharp claws penetrated Wang Chan's protective aura and easily tore his robe.
Tsk-
The evil ghost tiger exerted its force and tore off Wang Chan's right arm from his shoulder.
Blood spurted out from Wang Chan's shoulder like a fountain, staining a large area of ​​the sky red.
The arm that was still twitching fell from the sky with dripping blood.
Wang Chan's chest had been scratched to pieces, and his bones were exposed, making him look hideous and terrifying.
His facial features were twisted together due to severe pain, and a large mouthful of blood spurted out from his mouth.
However, it was too late to retreat at this moment.
"You evil beast, how dare you!"
Before he could recover from the severe pain of his broken arm, the Tiansha Ghost Tiger's tail, as thick as a steel whip, had already struck him in the abdomen with the sound of howling wind!
"Boom!"
With a loud noise, Wang Chan was like a rag doll hit by a boulder. His whole body was instantly flung out and hit the ground at an extremely fast speed.
Wang Chan hit the open space of the Monster Beast Courtyard hard, and a huge deep hole was instantly created on the ground.
His body was stuck in a deep pit, and his hands and feet were twisted at weird angles.
Wang Ying, who was in the corner, witnessed this scene with her own eyes. The blood on her face instantly faded away, and even her lips turned blue.
Her body fell limply to the ground, and the last glimmer of hope in her eyes was completely shattered.
Originally, she was still holding on to a bit of luck, hoping that her grandfather could turn the tide and kill the evil ghost tiger, and then kill Chu Feng to avenge her father and clan members.
But now...it's over, completely over.
At this moment, Wang Chan suddenly moved in the pit.
He raised his head with difficulty, his cloudy eyes staring at Chu Feng not far away, his eyes full of resentment.
"Why are you forcing me?"
The moment the words fell, Wang Chan's figure suddenly floated in mid-air.
Immediately afterwards, a blood-colored mist that was so thick and nauseating surged out of his body, spreading like a tide, and soon enveloped the entire City Lord's Mansion.
Wherever the bloody mist passed, the blood on the ground floated up and merged into the mist.
At the same time, Wang Chan's body shriveled up at a speed visible to the naked eye, and his skin became tight.It clings to the bones like a dehydrated mummy.
His eyes became increasingly scarlet, filled with an evil light.
Zi Shuhe stood aside, watching this strange scene, his face suddenly changed, and his heart suddenly thumped.
She seemed to have thought of something and exclaimed.
"No, he's going to use bloodline sacrifice!"
After hearing this, the expressions of the four elders and others changed.
It is a forbidden technique that has been lost for a long time. It is said that by using this technique, you can refine all the blood essence and blood of all your descendants for your own use, and forcibly enhance your own strength.
But the cost is huge. Not only will your life span be lost, but your descendants will also be cut off.
"Stop him quickly!"
Zi Shuhe reacted and rushed towards Wang Chan first.
The Fourth Elder and others did not dare to hesitate and began to use their spiritual power to prevent Wang Chan from using the forbidden technique.
However, Wang Chan just glanced at them coldly, raised his hand and slapped them with his palm.
The bloody mist condensed into a huge palm and slapped Zi Shuhe, the fourth elder and others hard.
"Bang!"
Everyone was unable to resist this strange force. They were instantly sent flying and hit the ground heavily. A mouthful of blood spurted out and they were unable to get up for a while.
Seeing this, the evil ghost tiger roared angrily, its huge body rushed towards Wang Chan like an arrow from the string, and its huge tiger claws struck Wang Chan hard.
However, the blood-colored mist around Wang Chan suddenly condensed into a thick blood-colored barrier, firmly protecting him.
"Boom!"
The tiger claws of the evil ghost tiger slapped the blood-colored barrier hard, making a deafening sound. The blood-colored barrier vibrated violently, causing ripples, but it never broke.
The evil ghost tiger slapped several claws one after another, but was unable to easily break the bloody barrier. It could only roar angrily and circle around Wang Chan.
At this moment, Wang Ying in the corner suddenly let out a shrill scream.
Wang Ying's body began to tremble uncontrollably, and a stream of light red air surged out of her seven orifices and floated towards Wang Chan in mid-air. It was the essence and blood in her body.
Wang Ying discovered to her horror that her body was drying out at a speed visible to the naked eye. Her skin had lost its luster and became wrinkled, and her hair had begun to turn gray.
It felt like an invisible hand had sucked away all her life.
"Grandpa, that's my blood essence, stop it!"
But Wang Chan seemed not to have heard it and still devoured her blood essence crazily.
Not only Wang Ying, but also everyone in her lineage had their essence and blood forcibly extracted, turning into streams of red air and blending into the blood-colored mist.
At this moment, Chu Feng took out a small jade bottle from his arms, uncorked it, and poured all the white medicinal powder inside into Wang Ying's mouth.
"Eat it quickly."
Wang Ying swallowed it subconsciously. She thought Chu Feng was aware of his conscience and wanted to save her life. A trace of gratitude flashed in her eyes and she spoke weakly.
"Thank you... thank you."
However, as soon as she finished speaking, a sharp pain suddenly came from her abdomen. The pain made her whole body twitch and her face instantly turned black.
"You...what did you feed me?"
Chu Feng said with an indifferent expression.
"Poison."
Wang Ying opened her mouth, wanting to curse Chu Feng, but she could only make a weak "ho ho" sound, her body twitched a few times, and then she lost her breath completely.
In mid-air, Wang Chan frantically devoured the essence and blood of all the descendants of the Wang family. The blood-colored mist around him became thicker and thicker, and his shriveled body began to expand at a speed visible to the naked eye.
The body that was originally like a mummy gradually became richer, and the skin became smooth again, even more rosy than before.
With the continuous influx of essence and blood, the aura on Wang Chan's body is also rising rapidly.
The first level of Nascent Soul, the second level of Nascent Soul, and the third level of Nascent Soul!
Zi Shuhe looked at Wang Chan's changes with anger in his eyes.
She struggled to get up from the ground, scolded angrily.
"Wang Chan, you actually have to refine your own bloodline relatives, but you're still not a human being!"
Wang Chan looked up to the sky and laughed, his laughter full of madness.
"You forced me to do this!"
He stared at Chu Feng and said hatefully.
"Chu Feng, my son is dead, my people are dead, and everything about me has been destroyed by you!
Today, all of you will die! "
The moment he finished speaking, Wang Chan no longer paid attention to the roaring Tiansha Ghost Tiger beside him, and rushed straight towards Chu Feng.
His current cultivation level has reached the third level of Nascent Soul. If he wants to kill Chu Feng, the evil spirits and ghost tigers may not be able to stop him.
When Zi Shuhe saw Wang Chan rushing towards Chu Feng, his breath suddenly stopped.
"Chu Feng, be careful!"
Wang Chan's speed was astonishingly fast. Almost at the moment Zi Shuhe's exclamation fell, he had already appeared in front of Chu Feng.
His eyes were full of crazy killing intent, and his right hand turned into a claw, and with a strong wind, he clawed hard at Chu Feng's head.
"Die!"
However, facing this fatal blow, Chu Feng stood motionless, with no trace of panic on his face, and even his eyes did not change, as if he was frightened.
Zi Shuhe's heart instantly rose to his throat, his eyes filled with despair.
"No--"
